06. Password Hashing vs Encryption

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Password hashing uses a one-way, slow verifier; encryption is reversible with the correct key.

slow password hash එකකින් verify කිරීම වඩා සුදුසුයි.
A database stores password verifiers, not readable passwords.
